sprint: Six-Day Method A Reproduction Sprint (7-13 November 2026)
milestone_gate: Gate 5 (Refined Method A Production Fracture Simulation Preparation)

warning_classification.pattern: ***WARNING: THE *ELEMENT OUTPUT OPTION IS NOT SUPPORTED FOR USER ELEMENTS

hpc_resource_specification.queue_architecture: Route queue directing to normal_imfdfkmq / short_imfdfkmq
hpc_resource_specification.execution_architecture: Single-rank serial Abaqus/Standard (authoritative reference anchor, strict single-rank UEL requirement)

loading_schedule.initial_state: Undeformed, undamaged, stress-free with rectangular notch (y in [0.499, 0.501] mm, x <= 0.500 mm)

step_1.name: Step-1
step_1.physical_meaning: Pre-critical linear-elastic loading up to 0.0050 mm displacement

step_2.name: Step-2
step_2.physical_meaning: Post-critical fracture propagation from 0.0050 mm to 0.0120 mm

reaction_force.source: *NODE OUTPUT and *NODE PRINT in Step-1 and Step-2

displacement.source: *NODE OUTPUT and *NODE PRINT in Step-1 and Step-2

phase_field_damage.components: SDV1 / SDV14 on companion elements (ELSET=umatelem), DOF 3 (U3) at physical nodes

companion_state_variables.components: MISESERI, MISESAVG, S, E, SDV (history field H=SDV2, degradation g=SDV15)

energy_balance.source: Dynamically written by f42_mixed_uel.for at every converged increment

restart_states.configuration: *RESTART, WRITE, FREQUENCY=1 in Step-1 and Step-2

telegram_integration.events: notify_start on initialization, terminal traps on COMPLETED / FAILED / TERMINATED

dual_channel_notifications_and_monitorin.duplicate_prevention: Unique job name M1_HOLE_F1664_METHOD_A_PROD, isolated scratch directory /scratch9/pr21vyci/runs/mode1_method_a_hole_f1664_prod

failure_recovery_policy.policy: No blind reruns or automated resubmissions. If non-convergence occurs, capture .msg, .dat, and .odb, diagnose the exact increment and equilibrium residual, and formulate an independently reviewed numerical hypothesis before any change.

criterion_1_convergence.description: Complete traversal of pre-critical loading (Step-1) and entry into post-peak softening regime (Step-2) through ligament severance and crack deflection.
criterion_1_convergence.threshold: Step-1 completed (u = 0.0050 mm) + Step-2 traversed past peak load with softening

criterion_2_numerical_stability.description: Absence of numerical divergence, NaN, Inf, or unhandled UEL/UMAT exceptions in any output field or energy file.
criterion_2_numerical_stability.threshold: Zero NaN/Inf in nodal displacements, reaction forces, or energy balance

criterion_3_force_displacement_response.description: Physically consistent P(u) curve exhibiting linear-elastic slope, distinct peak force, and smooth post-peak softening.
criterion_3_force_displacement_response.threshold: Linear initial response with stiffness matching benchmark, well-defined peak

criterion_4_peak_force_reproducibility.description: Peak reaction force P_max within expected physical bounds for the off-axis hole geometry.
criterion_4_peak_force_reproducibility.threshold: P_max in range [0.60, 0.80] kN, consistent with coarse reference (0.731 kN) and literature

criterion_5_crack_path_fidelity.description: Primary crack deflects into the circular hole; secondary crack initiates on the right hole boundary and propagates toward the right edge.
criterion_5_crack_path_fidelity.threshold: Topology matches Pandey-Kumar (2025) Figure 12 / 13 and coarse Job 1421063

criterion_6_energy_conservation.description: Fracture energy monotonically non-decreasing; global energy error bounded.
criterion_6_energy_conservation.threshold: d(W_frac)/dt >= 0; energy error within standard phase-field penalty tolerance

criterion_7_benchmark_comparison.description: Direct quantitative comparison against coarse reference (Job 1421063) and literature benchmark.
criterion_7_benchmark_comparison.threshold: Peak force, crack arrival displacement, and computational cost documented in comparative report
